quests.title: Resort Zone: the Pal Park's Fixed Catch mode (wild Pokémon by weekday)
Goldenrod Magnet Train Station: Prof. Rowan's Chimchar (missable; before the Plain Badge)

wild.place: Pal Park, Fixed Catch mode: Tuesday
notes: The wild table changes with the day of the week (by the DS clock). You get in through the Catching Show's Fixed Catch mode at the Pal Park reception ($10,000; bring your own Poké Balls). Sunday's table is the same as Cerulean Cave's, probably by mistake in the hack, so it also has Surf and fishing slots: the park has a pond and a stretch of sea.

acquisitions.conditions: After the Cianwood Gym story opens the Resort Zone, enter Pal Park’s Fixed Catch mode for $10,000 with room for six more Pokémon in the PC. This standing Pokémon appears on Tuesday or Thursday. Bring your own Poké Balls.
Speak to Prof. Rowan in Goldenrod Magnet Train Station with a free party slot before winning the Plain Badge; that win removes him permanently.
